box         = work
base        = pack:box.work
accent      = amber       title bars in KDOS-Amber (KWin rule kdos-box-work)
grant       = screencast, mystery
              screencast        the screen-cast portal, through KWin's own picker
            ! grant 'mystery' is no name KWin's sandbox policy or the bus proxy knows — it opens nothing
persistence = persistent  kdos-packd's upper, kept
network     = private     --unshare-netns
ipc         = private     --unshare-ipc
devices     = private     --unshare-devsys
processes   = private     --unshare-process
home        = shared      the user's own $HOME
wayland     = yes         the session's Wayland socket, tagged with this box's security context
audio       = no          no PipeWire socket
x11         = auto        Xwayland when the application has no Wayland path
memory      = unlimited   no --memory
cpus        = all         no --cpus
gpu         = no          no /dev/dri
